selected_sources.title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
selected_sources.version_history: v1 submitted 2026-10-09 12:41:51 UTC; v2 submitted 2026-10-17 09:57:43 UTC
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §§3.2–3.4 (printed pp. 4–6): agreement gate uses routed and auxiliary teachers' log-probability changes against a frozen reference; target gradient is corrected by removing conflicting components relative to an auxiliary gradient, with a norm-retention floor. The auxiliary loss constrains the target update; it is not an additional optimizer update.

selected_sources.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §§3.1.1–3.1.4 (printed pp. 7–10): successful trajectories populate a rolling shared buffer; failed contexts query successful segments via slope-constrained subsequence DTW; retrieved action chunks receive decaying sampling priorities for likelihood/flow-matching fine-tuning. §3.2 describes fault-tolerant asynchronous collection, optimization and policy distribution.

selected_sources.title: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §§3.1–3.3 (printed pp. 2–4): the paper evaluates a combined single-rollout asynchronous SPO/SPO++ recipe. Practical Muon approximately orthogonalizes momentum updates for hidden weight matrices; other parameters use AdamW. The recipe also includes token-averaged policy loss, truncated importance weights for rollout lag, and auxiliary length/tool-error penalties. Do not attribute the combined recipe's outcomes to Muon alone.

selected_sources.title: PyTorch Distributed: Experiences on Accelerating Data Parallel Training
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §§3.2–4 (printed pp. 3–7): DDP reduces ready gradient buckets with collective AllReduce, overlaps communication with backward computation, and permits skipped synchronization during accumulated local updates.

selected_sources.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §4 (printed pp. 4–5): freezes the pretrained backbone and jointly optimizes rank-16 LoRA adapters and a lightweight readout; causal masking allows one forward pass to produce features for multiple time points. The introduction and §5.5 describe a batched multi-LoRA kernel for many adapters on one shared backbone.

selected_sources.title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
selected_sources.original_locators: PDF §§3–4 (printed pp. 3–5): empirical analysis finds projector alignment saturates with a small data fraction and admits interpolable solutions. PORTAL computes a closed-form Gaussian optimal-transport map on a shared principal subspace from unpaired feature statistics, replacing the initial projector-training stage; subsequent joint multimodal training remains.
